about:
# AbsorbWatch
A simple addon to show absorb shields on health bars in WoW: Forever

releases.notes: Plays a sound when your absorb shield breaks or expires, with a choice of sound and volume channel in the settings. Restart the game after updating so it picks up the new sound files.
First release. Shows absorb shields on the player health bar and raid frames, with an optional absorb amount next to the player frame.
